title: Sell Mineral Rights in Friendly, WV
metaTitle: Sell Mineral Rights in Friendly, WV | Tyler County
metaDescription: Friendly, WV sits in Tyler County, deep in the Marcellus core. We buy mineral rights and heir shares here directly, verified against the Middlebourne record.
heroLead: Friendly is a small river town in Tyler County, a county whose name shows up constantly in Marcellus and Utica leasing activity because so much of it sits squarely in the core of the play.
intro: Tyler County's leasing history runs deep, both figuratively and literally: shallow oil production dating back generations, and among the most productive Marcellus and Utica/Point Pleasant acreage in the state layered underneath it. Friendly-area tracts often carry both, under separate leases negotiated decades apart.

We buy mineral and royalty interests around Friendly directly, and given how active Tyler County leasing has been, we check the current unit order and well count for your tract carefully before naming a figure.

sections.heading: Deep core acreage with a long leasing history
paragraphs: Friendly's position in Tyler County puts it inside some of the most consistently leased and drilled acreage in the entire Marcellus core. A tract here is more likely than most to already sit inside a multi-well unit, which changes how we approach valuing your interest.

sections.heading: Legacy oil leases still on the books
paragraphs: Tyler County's oil history predates the modern gas boom by decades. Some Friendly-area tracts still carry old shallow-well leases, occasionally flat-rate, that were never updated when West Virginia set its statutory minimum one-eighth royalty for conversion. We check for that before pricing an interest.

sections.heading: Heirship on tracts this heavily leased
paragraphs: Tracts with this much sustained leasing activity tend to have equally long ownership histories, meaning more generations, more heirs, and more fractional shares. We buy individual heir interests and handle the title work ourselves.

A Friendly-area interest that's been generating royalty for decades has usually been divided and re-divided as each generation passed it along, so the person receiving a check today may hold a smaller share of the original tract than they realize.

faqs.question: How many wells might be in a Friendly-area unit?
faqs.answer: Given the density of development in this part of Tyler County, multi-well units are common. We confirm the actual count from the current pooling order.

faqs.question: Is my family's old Tyler County lease a flat-rate lease?
faqs.answer: We check the recorded lease language, a fixed dollar figure per well indicates a flat-rate lease, which may qualify for statutory conversion to a royalty.

faqs.question: How many heirs typically share a Friendly-area interest?
faqs.answer: It varies, but given the length of leasing history here, interests with eight or more co-owners are common.
